meta.labelRule: purnimanta Krishna half: adhika -> (masa, adhika, null); else (masa of next nija lunation, nija, null); Shukla half = amanta label (incl. kshaya)
meta.lunationRow: [newMoonMs, newMoonRate, fullMoonMs, fullMoonRate, [[into, ms, v]], masa, adhika, kshaya|null, fragP, fragB]; into/masa/kshaya = Rashi/Masa ordinals (0 = MESHA/CHAITRA); rates = elongation (new/full moon) and sidereal Sun (v) rate, arcsec/s; fragP/fragB: label of the lunation changes when one new moon or sankranti moves by tau (30 s/600 s)
